map.由前后两次测得值与时间差求漂移率: Find the drift rate from two readings and the elapsed time
map.输入前后测得值与时间间隔，求漂移率。: Enter two readings taken before and after, plus the time interval, to get the drift rate.
map.📖 查看「由前后两次测得值与时间差求漂移率 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the drift rate from two readings and the elapsed time"
map.正漂移表示测得值随时间增大。: Positive drift means the measured value grows with time.
map.漂移率 = Δ读数 / 时间。例：24 h 变化 0.02 mV，漂移 0.00: Drift rate = Δreading / time. Example: a change of 0.02 mV over 24 h gives a drift of 0.00083 mV/h.
map.漂移率=(103.6−100)/12=0.3000 单位/天。若按此速率外推一个: Drift rate = (103.6 - 100)/12 = 0.3000 units/day. Extrapolated at this rate over one month the accumulated drift is about 9 units, so arrange an interim check or recalibration.
map.常给 %FS/℃，需控温或建温度补偿。: It is usually quoted as %FS/°C; control the temperature or build in temperature compensation.
map.长期漂移累积误差，需周期校准。: Long-term drift accumulates into error, so periodic calibration is required.
